results.name: Browser and CommonJS builds expose the same API
Ten levels of ten waves, the first four free, the rest one product
Every bud starts on the board, never overlaps another, and sways inside the walls
Rocks and the leaf sit between the flowers and the launcher, clear of every opening bud
Currents and tunnels are valid, and sit clear of the launcher and the opening buds
Each level brings its own twist and ends with a tougher boss
Cups turn away shots from below, but a shot from above or a crown blooms them
A puffcap blooms everything within reach and nothing past it
A boss that reaches the line costs a life and climbs back; blooming it blooms its wave
Drops wait for their time and for room at the top, and the wave only clears after the last one
Crystals slide, the leaf keeps its turn between waves, and turning never moves a rock
Swaying buds move side to side and fast ones fall faster
Progress saves stars, best score and furthest wave; levels open in order
Currents bend a shot without changing its speed
A tunnel sends a straight shot out of its partner at the exit heading
A shell only lets a shot in through its opening, and a crown chain blooms shelled buds anyway
A geode cracks into gems that must bloom before the wave clears, unless a big bloom takes it
Briars grow back unless the whole patch blooms in time
A practice bot clears every level, and the levels get harder
An average player sees a few Super Blooms and a handful of trick shots per level
Mashing does not pay, for these seeds: firing anywhere loses from level 3 on, rough aim at full speed loses 3, 4, 6 and 7 (it still wins some of 2, 5, 8 and 9) and costs far more lives than aiming
Every boss has a name
Wave hints fit on one short line
The whole suite runs in 40 seconds or less
